label: PF Backlog 203
title: Backend: per-unit cost model (per image/second/char/track/mesh) + costing at project creation/tier assignment
body:
## Problem / why
Cost is per-token only. Media bills per image / second / char / track / mesh, so project cost and
agent tier assignment cannot account for media.

## Goal & value
A per-unit cost model + costing integrated where decisions are made:
- at PROJECT CREATION: provisional tier + rough estimate,
- after the STRATEGY GATE (BI-0192): per-stage/agent cost projection incl. per-unit media costs,
- surface a free/paid mix; feed the budget allocator.

## In scope
- cost schema: billing_unit + unit_price per model; cost = unit_price x units.
- projection: N images x $, M seconds x $, K chars, T tracks, meshes.
- integrate with budget_planner / budget_allocator / tier assignment (agent gets tier+model WITH cost).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- A media project's projected cost reflects per-unit media pricing; a text project's is unchanged.
- Tier assignment exposes cost per agent/stage.

## Dependencies & links
- epic BI-0185; BI-0188/BI-0193 (kinds + units); BI-0076/0077 (fit); budget modules.

## Verification / test plan
- Given a 10s video + 20 images, the projection = sum of per-unit costs; recorded in the strategy artifact.
